doc.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996

title: The Basie tour with Sarah Vaughan and Basie arrangers
summary: Shearing and Williams recall touring with the Basie band, Sarah Vaughan, Jimmie Jones, Richard Davis, Roy Haynes and charts by Al Cohn, Ernie Wilkins and Quincy Jones.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: Well you and I have experienced some things with the Basie tour, night after night after night with them.
Yes. Listening to Sarah Vaughan and Jimmie Jones and Richard Davis and Roy Haynes with the Basie band playing those wonderful charts. Some by Al Cohn, some by Ernie Wilkins.

And Quincy too, yeah, he had charts by Quincy at that time. And we’d get in the audience and you’d be wet as I remember. You had your towel on, to listen to her in that group make music. Well there was a lot of things happening musically. You became very innovative though, with the Latin rhythms. You went through your Latin period there that was very exciting I thought.
